single_portfolio.purpose: Total == the one book; scope resolution baseline.

two_portfolios.purpose: Disjoint sub-scopes sum to the two-book total.

empty_portfolio.purpose: No rows: controlled empty result, never a fabricated zero KPI.

mixed_currency.purpose: Monetary totals suppressed; count shares still valid.

missing_currency.purpose: No currency field: totals allowed but flagged as unverified currency.

null_currency.purpose: Null currency values must not be treated as a distinct currency.

duplicate_loan_ids_within.purpose: Dedup / identity integrity within one book.

duplicate_ids_across_portfolios.purpose: Composite key needed; must not collapse two loans.

missing_provenance.purpose: No source_portfolio_id: lens scoping degrades to Total with disclosure.

two_reporting_dates.purpose: Point-in-time resolves as-of-latest, never aggregates both.

stale_only.purpose: Requested date unavailable: adjust to prior and disclose the gap.

zero_balances.purpose: Zero exposure: shares undefined, not divide-by-zero.

zero_weights.purpose: Weighted average must be None, never a simple-mean fallback.

negative_weights.purpose: Negative weights excluded from the positive-weight denominator.

all_null_dimension.purpose: All-null dimension: single (unknown) bucket == full population.

unknown_categories.purpose: Unknown bucket kept in the denominator; shares still sum to 1.

high_cardinality_dimension.purpose: One category per loan: deterministic ranking, no crash.

conflicting_asset_class.purpose: Conflicting asset classes must not be silently merged.

missing_asset_class.purpose: No asset-class declaration: asset-specific fields not applied.
